description: An open-source toolbox for animal pose estimation, expanded to include multi-animal pose estimation, data-driven assembly, and network flow-based tracking.

A multi-scale neural network architecture for multi-animal pose estimation and individual assembly, leveraging Part Affinity Fields (PAFs) and data-driven skeleton construction within the DeepLabCut ecosystem.
An open-source toolbox for markerless pose estimation and multi-animal tracking, featuring assembly algorithms, identity re-identification, and a tracklet stitching system for kinematic consistency.

A multi-animal pose estimation and tracking system extending DeepLabCut that supports identity tracking, reID, unsupervised metric learning, and both bottom-up and top-down pose estimation pipelines for long-term behavioral analysis.
An open-source toolbox for markerless pose estimation of animals and humans that allows for tracking of body parts across frames, supporting both GUI and programmatic interfaces.

Multi-task deep-learning architecture for keypoint detection and animal pose estimation, comprising a deep CNN backbone with multiple deconvolutional layers, utilizing score maps, vector fields, and part affinity fields (PAFs).
A toolbox for markerless pose estimation that supports multi-animal tracking, identity prediction, and data-driven part affinity field (PAF) graph selection.
A multi-animal pose estimation framework using graph-based assembly, affinity costs, and calibration via multivariate normal distributions for keypoint linkage.
An open-source toolbox for pose estimation tasks, supporting various backbones (HRNet, ResNet) and grouping algorithms like Associative Embedding for bottom-up pose estimation.
A tool for reconstructing full trajectories from sparse tracklets of animal tracking data by casting the stitching task as a network flow minimization problem.

An open-source toolbox for markerless pose estimation and animal tracking that includes modules for tracklet stitching, unsupervised ID tracking using metric learning with transformers, and tracking performance evaluation.
